LOHERA Name: 1-3 Market Chambers- Address: Church Street, Enfield- Type: Shop- Local Heritage Asset: A well-detailed, three storey stone-faced building in the Beaux Arts style dating from 1920.  Prominent in the streetscape with two principal elevations; the east elevation is a key element contributing to the character and enclosure of the Market Place.

decision_conditions: The premises shall only be open to customers between the hours of 07:00 and 00:00 daily. Outgoing customer delivery collections and dispatches only may take place between 00:00 and 02:00 daily, during which time no customers shall be permitted within the premises. All activities associated with the use, including deliveries, collections, servicing and staff activities, must cease within 1 hour of closing time.Reason: To safeguard the amenities of the local area and the living conditions of nearby residential occupiers.
description: Variation of condition 1 of approval 14/04455/VAR to allow the restaurant to trade between the hours of 07:00 and 24:00 daily, with outgoing customer deliveries permitted until 02:00 daily, with no customers permitted within the premises and all activity associated with use ceasing within an hour of closing.
